description: This file defines a utility class `dmUtility` with static methods for string manipulation, parsing, and query processing, used within a larger software system.

classes.name: dmUtility
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for string processing and query manipulation.

methods.name: void splitQuery(char const * query,char * parameter)
methods.description: Extracts the substring after the last '.' or '\' character from the query string and stores it in the parameter buffer.

methods.name: bool has_suffix(const std::string & str,const std::string & suffix)
methods.description: Checks if a given string ends with the specified suffix.

methods.name: bool isWildcard(char const * s)
methods.description: Determines if the provided string ends with a '.' character, indicating a wildcard.

methods.name: std::string trimWildcard(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the trailing '.' from a string if it exists.

methods.name: std::string trimProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the last '.' and subsequent characters from a string, returning the property path.

methods.name: std::string trimPropertyName(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the prefix up to the last '.' in a string, returning the property name.

methods.name: std::string trimSetProperty(std::string const & s)
methods.description: Removes the '= { ... }' set notation if present, or trims property otherwise.

methods.name: bool parseMultisetValue(std::string const & s,std::vector<std::pair<std::string,std::string>> & nameVals)
methods.description: Parses a multiset value string formatted with braces and key-value pairs into a vector of pairs.

methods.name: void splitString(std::string const & s,char delim,std::vector<std::string> & out)
methods.description: Splits a string by a specified delimiter into a vector of substrings.
